serverInfo.name: fatture-in-cloud-mcp
serverInfo.title: Fatture in Cloud MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Fatture in Cloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still unpaid, and when are they due?"; "List this month's supplier expenses with their totals."; "Create an invoice for Rossi S.r.l. with these lines at 22% VAT.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fatture in Cloud data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fattureincloud_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fattureincloud_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fattureincloud_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fattureincloud_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

q.description: Filter in Fatture in Cloud's query language, for example name like '%Rossi%' or date >= '2026-01-01' and date <= '2026-03-31'. Large reference tables are left out unless you ask for them in include: vat_types (also in fattureincloud_list_settings), currencies, countries, e_invoice_codes (SDI document types, regimes, cassa, withholding and payment reason codes) and e_invoice_structure (the XML field limits).

tools.name: fattureincloud_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a product or service in a company's catalogue. Returns the new product with its id.

company_id.description: The company id (from fattureincloud_list_companies). Optional when the sign-in reaches only one company.

net_price.description: Price without VAT, in the company currency (euro), for example 100.5.

gross_price.description: Price with VAT; use it instead of net_price for gross pricing.

vat_id.description: Default VAT type id (fattureincloud_list_settings kind vat_types).

measure.description: Unit of measure, for example ore or pz.

tools.name: fattureincloud_create_issued_document
tools.title: Create an issued document
tools.description: Create an invoice, quote, proforma, receipt, delivery note, credit note or order. It gets the next number unless you give one. Give client_id (the tool copies the stored client's details, as Fatture in Cloud does not fill them in) or a client object. Each item needs a vat_id (fattureincloud_list_settings kind vat_types). Without payments, invoices, proformas, receipts and credit notes get one unpaid payment of the full total, due on due_date or the document date. This does NOT send anything: e-mail it with fattureincloud_send_document_email or send an e-invoice with fattureincloud_send_einvoice.

company_id.description: The company id (from fattureincloud_list_companies). Optional when the sign-in reaches only one company.

client.description: A customer that is not in the registry (one-off). Use client_id instead for a stored client.

type.description: company, person, pa (public administration) or condo.

country.description: Country name in Italian, for example Italia.

ei_code.description: E-invoice recipient code (Codice destinatario, 7 characters; 6 for public administration).

number.description: Document number; default the next free number.

notes.description: Notes printed on the document (HTML allowed by Fatture in Cloud).

use_gross_prices.description: true = item prices include VAT (gross_price). Default false.

net_price.description: Unit price without VAT (when use_gross_prices is false).

gross_price.description: Unit price with VAT (when use_gross_prices is true).

not_taxable.description: true = not counted as revenue (for example the stamp-duty line Bollo in fattura).

amount.description: Amount with VAT. All payments must add up to the document's amount due.

due_date.description: Due date of the automatic single payment (YYYY-MM-DD).

e_invoice.description: true = an electronic invoice for the SDI. The customer needs ei_code or certified_email.

ei_payment_method.description: E-invoice payment method code (ModalitaPagamento), for example MP05 bank transfer. Required for e-invoices.

ei_vat_kind.description: VAT due: I immediate, D deferred, S split payment.

tools.name: fattureincloud_send_document_email
tools.title: E-mail an issued document
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: e-mail an issued document to the customer from Fatture in Cloud. Use only when the user asks to send it. Recipient, sender, subject and body default to Fatture in Cloud's suggestions for this document. Other files (attachment, delivery note, accompanying invoice) go only when you ask for them.

company_id.description: The company id (from fattureincloud_list_companies). Optional when the sign-in reaches only one company.

recipient_email.description: Recipient address(es), comma-separated. Default: the customer's address.

sender_email.description: One of the company's sender addresses. Default: the company's default sender.

body.description: Message text (HTML allowed). Default: Fatture in Cloud's template text.

attach_pdf.description: Attach the document PDF. Default: the company's own setting for this document (default_attach_pdf), else true.

send_copy.description: Send a copy to the sender (default false).

include_attachment.description: Also include the document's attached file, if it has one (default false).

include_delivery_note.description: Also include the linked delivery note, if any (default false).

include_accompanying_invoice.description: Also include the accompanying invoice, if any (default false).

tools.name: fattureincloud_send_einvoice
tools.title: Send an e-invoice to the SDI
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: send an issued e-invoice (e_invoice true) to the Italian exchange system SDI. Use only when the user asks to send it. Run fattureincloud_verify_einvoice_xml first; dry_run true checks the send without sending.

company_id.description: The company id (from fattureincloud_list_companies). Optional when the sign-in reaches only one company.

dry_run.description: true = validate only, send nothing (default false).

annotations.title: Send an e-invoice to the SDI
